Effect

A live effect, which derives what is drawn from an item without changing the item itself, as the effects in Illustrator do. Creating one registers it under its type, replacing any effect registered there before, and items use it by that type, see item.effects, each through an EffectInstance with its own parameters.

Constructors

Effect(props)

Creates an effect and registers it under its type.

    Parameters:

  • props: Object — the type of the effect, its label and parameters, and onApply and onEditParameters

    Returns:

  • Effect

Properties

type

The type that the effect is registered under, and that items use it by.

Read only.

    Type:

  • String
label

The label of the effect, for hosts to show to users.

Read only.

    Default:

  • the type

    Type:

  • String
parameters

The declared parameters of the effect by their names, as objects that describe them for hosts to build their settings from, with the default as their value, e.g. { label: 'Amount', type: 'number', range: [0, 100], value: 10 }. The instances of the effect have them as properties.

Read only.

    Type:

  • Object
onApply

The function that applies the effect, called with the instance as this, and returning what the effect makes of the art that it gets, which it doesn’t change.

    Type:

  • Function⟋null

    Options:

  • event.art: Item — the item to apply the effect to, or what the effect before it returned
  • event.item: Item — the item that the instance is part of
onEditParameters

The function that hosts call when the user edits the parameters of an instance, with the instance as this, to set its properties. Paper.js itself doesn’t call it.

    Type:

  • Function⟋null

Methods

remove()

Removes the effect from the registered effects.

    Returns:

  • Boolean — true if the effect was registered, false otherwise

Static Methods

Effect.add(effect)

Registers the effect under its type, replacing any effect registered there before. Effects register themselves when they are created.

    Parameters:

  • effect: Effect

    Returns:

  • Effect — the effect
Effect.get(type)

Returns the effect registered under the type.

    Parameters:

  • type: String

    Returns:

  • Effect⟋null — the effect, or null
Effect.getAll()

Returns all registered effects.

    Returns:

  • Array of Effect objects — the effects
Effect.remove(effect)

Removes the effect from the registered effects.

    Parameters:

  • effect: Effect

    Returns:

  • Boolean — true if the effect was registered, false otherwise
